title: Language models seek help despite guaranteed score losses in question answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.29981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: At the highest waiting cost in a multiple-choice question-answering task, all 7 tested open-weight language models still consult an expert even though a correct expert answer earns fewer points than an incorrect independent answer. Pooling over expert accuracy and fixed-fee combinations gives help-seeking rates of 20.8% to 94.1% across models. We test 2,291 questions across 54 combinations of expert accuracy and consultation costs, comparing observed decisions with an expected-score baseline based on independently measured and calibrated model confidence. Help-seeking rates vary across conditions with the same expected consultation score. Fine-tuning reduces decision regret by 59% to 87% on held-out questions within the training range but increases inconsistency at matched expected consultation scores. In a separate task, external routing improves scores by 0.180 to 0.273 points per question with candidate answers held fixed.

translated_title: 语言模型在问答任务中即使面临确定的分数损失仍会寻求帮助
translated_abstract: 在多项选择题问答任务中，即使处于最高的等待成本，所有7个受测的开源权重语言模型仍会咨询专家，即便专家给出正确答案所得的分数低于独立回答错误时的得分。汇总专家准确率与固定收费的各种组合，各模型的求助率介于20.8%到94.1%之间。我们在54种专家准确率与咨询成本组合下测试了2,291道题目，将观察到的决策与基于独立测量并校准的模型置信度所构建的期望得分基线进行比较。结果显示，在期望咨询得分相同的条件下，求助率仍随条件而变化。微调使训练范围内的保留题目上的决策遗憾减少59%至87%，但在匹配的期望咨询得分下增加了不一致性。在另一个独立任务中，在候选答案保持不变的情况下，外部路由使每题得分提高0.180至0.273分。
tldr: 该研究系统量化了语言模型在成本-收益权衡下的求助决策，发现即使求助必然导致分数损失，各模型仍会咨询专家，且微调可将决策遗憾减少59%至87%，外部路由则能进一步提升答题得分。
en_tdlr: This study systematically quantifies language models' help-seeking decisions under cost-benefit trade-offs, showing that models still consult experts despite guaranteed score losses, that fine-tuning reduces decision regret by 59%–87%, and that external routing further improves per-question scores.
